description: This file defines Express.js routes for development and debugging purposes, including endpoints to check database connection status, seed initial data into MongoDB collections, and verify data availability across collections.

methods.name: router.get('/db-status')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve MongoDB connection status, including connection state, database name, and host.

methods.name: router.get('/seed')
methods.description: Endpoint to seed sample data into multiple collections if they are empty, returning counts and sample documents.

methods.name: router.get('/verify')
methods.description: Endpoint to verify data availability by returning counts and first few documents from each collection.
